from pathlib import Path

repo = Path("/Users/steventran/jobpipe")

jobspy = repo / "utils" / "jobspy_source.py"
text = jobspy.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
text = text.replace(
'''                        job_url = _clean(row.get("job_url"))
                        description = _clean(row.get("description"))
''',
'''                        job_url = _clean(row.get("job_url"))
                        direct_url = _clean(row.get("job_url_direct"))
                        description = _clean(row.get("description"))
'''
)
text = text.replace(
'''                            apply_url=job_url,
''',
'''                            apply_url=direct_url or job_url,
''',
1
)
text = text.replace(
'''                                "source": site,
                                "date_posted": date_posted,
''',
'''                                "source": site,
                                "date_posted": date_posted,
                                "job_url_direct": direct_url,
''',
1
)
jobspy.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

queue = repo / "jobpipe_queue.py"
text = queue.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
text = text.replace(
'''    identities: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
''',
'''    identities: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
    by_role: dict[tuple[str, str], dict[str, str]] = {}
'''
)
text = text.replace(
'''        for row in existing:
            identities.add((
                row.get("company", "").strip().casefold(),
                row.get("job_title", "").strip().casefold(),
                row.get("job_url", "").strip(),
            ))
''',
'''        for row in existing:
            company_key = row.get("company", "").strip().casefold()
            title_key = row.get("job_title", "").strip().casefold()
            identities.add((company_key, title_key, row.get("job_url", "").strip()))
            by_role[(company_key, title_key)] = row
'''
)
old = '''        identity = (company.casefold(), title.casefold(), url)
        if identity in identities:
            continue
        score = int(job.get("match_score") or 0)
        existing.append({
            "company": company,
            "job_title": title,
            "job_url": url,
            "priority": _priority(score),
            "status": "Pending",
            "resume_variant": "",
            "source": str(job.get("source") or job.get("platform") or ""),
            "match_score": str(score),
            "notes": str(job.get("reasoning") or ""),
        })
        identities.add(identity)
        added += 1
'''
new = '''        company_key = company.casefold()
        title_key = title.casefold()
        identity = (company_key, title_key, url)
        score = int(job.get("match_score") or 0)
        existing_row = by_role.get((company_key, title_key))
        if existing_row is not None:
            existing_row["job_url"] = url
            existing_row["priority"] = _priority(score)
            existing_row["source"] = str(job.get("source") or job.get("platform") or "")
            existing_row["match_score"] = str(score)
            existing_row["notes"] = str(job.get("reasoning") or "")
            identities.add(identity)
            continue
        if identity in identities:
            continue
        row = {
            "company": company,
            "job_title": title,
            "job_url": url,
            "priority": _priority(score),
            "status": "Pending",
            "resume_variant": "",
            "source": str(job.get("source") or job.get("platform") or ""),
            "match_score": str(score),
            "notes": str(job.get("reasoning") or ""),
        }
        existing.append(row)
        by_role[(company_key, title_key)] = row
        identities.add(identity)
        added += 1
'''
text = text.replace(old, new, 1)
queue.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

print("JobSpy now prefers direct employer URLs")
print("enqueue refreshes existing company/title rows when apply URLs improve")
